message: Verity: ../q/x.ts changed, but no check has passed since the last edit. Run the project's checks and fix what fails before finishing. A test, build, lint, or type-check command counts, run so its own exit status is the result: a pipe into `tail`, `|| true`, or a trailing `; echo` hides it. If no check applies to this change, say so explicitly and stop again (a repeated stop releases the gate only where the project's trusted .verity.json opts into the release valve).
